text: Excellent music, vibe and pizza.
awesome time here always! staff are so kind and welcoming and great vibes atmosphere! LOVE GLOZET!!!! support the local charlottesville community🌈
Pizza was amazing and highly recommend the garlic knots!

Got 3 drinks that should have been around 20$, got charged 43$. I asked the total as the bartender wouldn't show me the screen when paying, and they said 37$, which shocked me and then I go to find out they put in their own tip as well. I was overcharged by a lot and am dissatisfied by that, otherwise I loved the atmosphere and service was sweet and efficient.
Bar tender was really cool. Good special on domestics. Nice life music on a sat afternoon.
One of the most incompetent bouncers ever. What a shame.

There were fruit flies when we dined here. It was a Friday afternoon and looks like they just opened and may have forgotten to clean the night before. Other than that, the food is great, pretty nostalgic pizza taste, and that Beer Dip Sauce (?) is a nice addition. The female staff is attentive and courteous, the male one chose to have his beer first before starting to work (he’s probably the bar tender).
At 11pm on Saturday I was denied entrance by a rude man. They should update their hours of operation and have saved me the walk.

Pizza was okay
Service was below my expectations
Atmosphere is not my vibes
The bartender kris was incredible!! Love her so much

The quality of crozet has gone way downhill in the last year. We have come every single week in the last two years, so I’ve been here to see the whole journey. They now charge automatic tips for zero service, bring out burnt or underdone pizza, and seem to be inconvenienced by our presence. Requiring us to order at the bar and then upcharging us for nothing is insane.

This place has really gone downhill over the past year. The pizza quality is EXTREMELY hit or miss, and they automatically add a 20% gratuity for very little service. The only reason I even go anymore is for trivia night on Tuesdays. This place used to be amazing.

Have been coming here since I got to uva. I’ve always loved them, but their pizza quality has tanked and they just started applying mandatory 20% gratuity on bills. This is not a sit down restaurant or a place where service is provided other than them bringing your pizza and leaving. This kind of mandatory gratuity is ridiculous.

On a quick weekend to visit Charlottesville and found this hidden gem off Main.  Walked in and Brendan(?) happily greeted us and then brought us a pitcher of water to start.  We ordered three different pizzas and each was amazing!  The garlic knots are really, really good too.  If you get a chance to look at their menu, the options are endless for toppings.  The crust.... So good! And we also ordered a side of jalapeno ranch that was really the right dip for our pizza. I highly recommend stopping by and saying hi to Brendan and grab a pizza!

Love this place -- Awesome pizza!! And I'm pretty picky!! Recommend going in the summer, and after 6pm. Next to no one here and able to park in a closed business lot nearby. Say outside at the picnic tables there. And a treat for the kids to have a train come by so close!! Fun ambiance. <3
Cozy. Off the beaten path. Indoor & outdoor seating. Pizza tasted great. Salad was fresh. Prices very fair.
Rude workers, do not come here

This is the burned bottom of my calzone.  I  flipped it upside down so you can see it.  I expected  more from this place.  I normally get a good calzone but someone dropped the ball on this one.  It should not have left the shop.  The only reason I gave the dinner 2 stars was because I had their Caesar salad which is delicious.  BTW, this burned calzone was my birthday dinner.  Oh well.
It's not an ideal place to visit with family, but pizza is really delicious, and variety is fine. It's also not a huge place, but good place for small/med friend groups.
Delicious pizza and friendly staff!
Stopped off here for dinner. Excellent pizza, great atmosphere and the service was fab. Highly recommend.

visiting the area, decided to try out based on previous reviews.

Ordered two small
Buddhist and Capone.

Baked to perfection, toppings excellent.
Crispy bottom
Server had problems with the order done and was a delay, very apologetic, offered free drinks.
No problem, the wait was worth it.
will return.
Pizza crust was amazing.  Mixed drinks not great...probably best to stick to beer or soft drinks.

Got two pizzas to go and had some drinks at the bar. The college atmosphere was definitely in full effect. Drinks we're good and cheap and the pizzas were absolutely amazing. The pizza was cooked perfectly, "great undercarriage", the sauce, toppings, and cheese were all generous. Great stuff.
Cute little dive with decent pizza. Great area near the campus.
My question is why would you give reusable glasses when you’re told to throw them out. I think that’s something fun to keep to remember your experience. Aside from that, service was great.
So glad we found this place...delicious pizza, outstanding service, and nice outdoor seating!

I was beyond excited to introduce a friend to what I thought was a local gem, but what we experienced was nothing short of a nightmare. The food was so shockingly bad that we couldn't bring ourselves to take more than a bite. The pizza was soggy, flavorless, and resembled something you'd find in a school cafeteria dumpster. To make matters worse, the staff appeared to be high, and the whole place smelled like pot.

Adding insult to injury, the host, who was supposed to be managing the front of the house, was lounging at a booth with friends, openly drinking. It was incredibly unprofessional and gave the impression that customer service is not a priority at this establishment.

I am appalled by the lack of respect for customers and the total disregard for food quality. I will be disputing the charge for this meal on my credit card, as it was inedible and a complete waste of money. Save yourself the disappointment and avoid this place at all costs.
One of my favorite college bars
The pizza was good, and was ready for take out quickly. The wings were good too, but they gave us barbecue instead of buffalo sauce. I'd definitely get food from there again

Be aware of the automatic 20% gratuity charge (We were a party of 2). There is no mention of an automatic gratuity on the online menu, that they direct you to use, either. Make sure you ask for a physical copy of the receipt to ensure you’re being charged correctly. We were charge full price for happy hour drinks. The server, who came to our table without a pen or paper, also rang my order wrong. I received a pizza instead of a calzone, but I happily accepted because I didn’t mind the pizza.

2 stars because the food and drinks were good.
Pizza when i was out, so good <3
Pizza was mediocre, overpriced for what you order. Personally would not order again.
Such a wonderful gem on the Corner! The signature zen drink was delicious, bartender McKayla was very capable and friendly, what a great smile! Live band also fantastic.
College bar. Nice patio area. The veg calzone was not good. Swimming in grease. The filling left much to be desired. Good service! Very friendly and attentive.
Not the same as the original Crozet Pizza.  Different owners as I was told.

Food is delish, service was just awful.  Had to ask twice for a beer which then sat on the bar while the bartender just relaxed (instead of delivering it) until the server finally picked it up.  Beer ended up arriving just before dinner, it took that long.  Server suggested garlic knots since they had an extra one just come out of the oven yet it took 10min for it to be delivered and then we had to ask for silverware.
Pizza was OK.  Not the Crozet Pizza I knew which is in Crozet.  My taste said there is a difference.  Probably a good college town pizza.  Just expecting more.  Good luck.
One of the special spots in town. Big open patio! Great food and staff is amazing
Great live band when I was there!
Cool place... pizza great!

I have eaten here MANY times and while the pizza is ehhhh it is definitely better than most places on the corner. Avoid the calzones. Order some Johnny Knots. Don't go here past 6pm if you want to avoid undergrads swamping the joint.
Great pizza and laid-back atmosphere!
The Big Yang pizza is great, good gluten free crust but regular peppeoni pizza was dry & barely had sauce or cheese.
Best cheesy garlic knots!  Pizza was thin but okay. Overall good!
Any white pie is super good. Pizza here is over all one of my favorites. Worked on building the outdoor bar with my dad. One of my favorite places to go in Charlottesville.

Food was decent, the atmosphere was pleasant enough, but the pricing was way too high for what we received.

$60 for 2 medium pizzas and an appetizer is simply asking too much. We won't be back for this reason.

Favorite place in Charlottesville! Best pizza in town and the garlic knots are top notch. The staff is very friendly and helpful. After eating dinner here I returned for their night life, the live music was fantastic and the bartenders were great and provided speedy service. I will definitely be returning.

This is a corky little place. It's a bar in a somewhat anonymous looking house, that serves a pretty good pizza.
All the seating seems to be outside, but the bench we sat at, had a bit too much bird droppings - it would have been nice if it was wiped clean, at least when we sat down.
There was a DJ playing music, alongside the music played in the outside speakers. It was a bit annoying, but the DJ eventually stopped, leaving only the speakers playing music, wich was better.
Kristi was a joyful helpful server  .. the best !!!
Inventive pizzas that works. The outdoor seating unfortunately gets music blasted from competing speakers so a bit annoying
Staff could be more familiar with beer selections; took several back and forths to get answers to simple question
Pizza was bland

Great pizza but pricey with a large pizza at $25+ . Good for offering vegan cheese options for Calzones and pizzas. Nice selection of draft beers and one local draft cider (boldrock IPA - one of my faves).
Best pizza around
The bar at night here is charging exorbitant prices for simple drinks. Over $37 for a Jack and Coke plus a double shot of Jameson...

My girlfriend was accused of being rude while in the bar by one of the employees. She had been quietly talking to her friends and hadn't even spoken to anyone else. One of the workers put her hands on her and physically pushed her as she was trying to leave the bar. I wouldn't recommend anyone frequent this establishment.
The pizza here was excellent and the atmosphere was even better. Really enjoyed our experience here and definitely will be back!

Horrible customer service messed my order up told me don’t worry I would receive a credit for the mishap. Called we told there was nothing they could do and nobody had put my name down. Mind you I spent about 75$ for two pizza and a tip.. will not be eating here ever again….
Bobby is my favorite bartender in cville! He’s always so friendly and makes the best drinks.

Visited on July 31st , and the food was cooked perfectly, and the staff were fantastic !!!!
Great place with great vibe.
The staff here are so lovely! Great pizza, but even better service! And fantastic brews!
Very rude bartenders and crammed atmosphere

The pizza was great but picking up was infuriating. When I called in my order my order I asked if they offered curbside pick up since I would have kids in the car. The lady said sure no problem. I get there to pick it up and an employee Katie answers. When I mentioned that someone had told me they'd bring it out she just says, "yeah, well, we're slammed" and hangs up. I call back and Katie then pretends she can't hear me on the phone and hangs up again. Finally the lady that took my order answered and brought it out. Not sure what Katie's beef is but she certainly shouldn't be interacting with their customers.
Spectacular staff, beer, and pizza!

Pizza is great but went on a Monday @4PM and the establishment was closed with nobody inside (chairs still up, lights off, no one picking up our calls, etc.).  The website hours for the Elliewood location indicate that it should have opened at 3pm for Monday's hours, but clearly it did not. There was no sign around to update the change and we waited for ~10 minutes in case someone would open, but there wasn't anyone nearby. We even paid for parking at the nearby lot but obviously could not be refunded. Disappointed because the food is usually great, but the hours as indicated on the website are not consistent, as they opened more than an hour late.
Our garlic knots were cold and seemed a bit old. As if they had been sitting out all day. Decent service but not the best pizza on Cville
Great customer service
Terrible food, terrible service. Extremely disappointed for what used to be good food.

Easily some of the worst service I have ever been provided. Ordered focaccia and beer cheese and was brought a cold order that appeared to have been leftover from someone else. We asked if the cheese and bread were supposed to be cold, only be served reheated cheese with the same cold bread when they attempted to fix our order. Not only that, we were never asked our drink orders and instead had to hunt down the waitresses despite sitting at the bar. Do yourself a favor and go to Christian's or Mellow.

Very confused that this place is so highly rated. The pizza was awful. It was so bad that I ate a single slice, then found something else to eat at home. I didn’t bother to save what was left over. I’m new to the area and wanted to try something new but it was one big nope. I ordered a cheese pizza and it was basically the texture and flavor of cardboard with barely any topping on it.
I had the fun guy pizza and it was amazing...
Great pizza ,friendly staff and fun environment
Decent pizza for drunk people

First time that I seat in a restaurant and leave before ordering. After several failed attempts with their online ordering system just gave up and left. Too much hassle to place an order. Bad music playing too loudly.

First time ordering. We ordered 2 salads with Vinaigrette and Ranch dressings, cheesy knots and a large Feisty Italian. The food was very underwhelming. Both salads had bitter lettuce, and cukes , which made it inedible. The pizza was ok, not great by an means. The cheesy knots were good and the most edible thing on the order. Disappointed as I have heard good things from them, but based on my experience I will not be going back or ordering from there again.
Very good white pizza, and friendly staff 😊
Got take out. Forget which. probably  Uber or Grub Hub.
A bit pricey but really good overall I got the calzone and it was fantastic
Best pizza in Charlottesville. We tried the Capone, emerald and fun guy. Each pizza was unique in taste and really good. Can’t wait to be back to try more.
One of the few places on the Corner doing live music!!!

We had a great time!! Live band playing, yummy cocktails and of course pizza! We did a half and half medium pizza, my half the vegetarian called Emerald (pesto, artichoke, tomato) and the other half the Big Yang (buffalo chicken and bacon and spicy ranch). Everything was awesome, I highly recommend!
not bad
Great food and cool ambiance.

Truly disappointing food. Gummy, pale, and limp pizza that tastes like garlic and nothing else. Undercooked, soggy garlic knots. Grainy cheese dip. Nothing redeeming.

Would not recommend and do not plan to return.
Best Pizza in the world

Service was great. We sat outside in 50degree weather because of Covid restrictions but the propane heater was just fine. The waitress was great, she checked up juat enough and had our food and drinks ready quick. Not sure if it was the owner or manager who was there to help but he was very nice and got the propane heater up and working for us when we were seated. The patio is very nice and well lit and some people bear us had a small dog who was well behaved that the waitress brought out a water bowl for. I am eager to go back.
The pizza was delicious. I'm not even a real big fan of thin crust but somehow they loaded up this this crust so it was reminiscent of Chicago style pizza in flavor depth and profile. And it was still very filling.
I highly recommend. Even if you have to get take out because everything is closed down this place is well worth the trip out in the cold to grab your food. And you can easily order online.
Highly recommend.
Not the best place
Awesome Pizza!

They wanted $60 for one large pizza and one medium pizza and 2 apps. When I asked the guy what the prices were for each item he said he didn't have time to explain.  No thanks if you are going to be rude.

This a sweet spot downtown charlottesville. We stopped here for chow after hiking crab tree falls. There was only one server whose name.i can't recall on a really nice Saturday afternoon that took the time and effort to check on us very often, made sure our needs were met despites the fact that she was the only one and they had a decent crowd. The establishment was clean and the pizzas were delightfully delicious. My girlfriend is a picky vegetarian while I eat all meat everything but she was very pleasently surprised with the quality of the veggy pizza she got. We marked it as a spot where we will be returning.
Excellent pizza.  Reliably good service.  And a fun atmosphere!
Great pizza. Some creative and original choices.
Pizza tasted great, but finding the online menu wasn’t intuitive
The Pizza is awesome!!!!
Pizza was phenomenal. Easily grabbed a top 5 slot for me on the first slice. Staff was very accommodating and the ordering process was super easy during these crazy times of covid

For a vegetarian, this place has a lot of good options. I usually go for the "Yummus Hoagie". It is prepared using fresh veggies, the perfect toasted sub, and great hummus and vinaigrette. Definitely recommend this if you are looking for a vegetarian option on the corner.
Calzone was awesome!
Great pizza and music
Yes, you CAN get Crozet Pizza in Charlottesville. It's outstanding.
Great place for pizza or drinks. The appetizers were much larger than expected. There's great ambiance here on a Friday night and a nice place to catch a game too.
Great food, awesome place, and great atmosphere!

Way too much oregano / Italian seasoning.  I got through less than one slice and could not eat any more. What I paid was way too much for less than 1 slice of pizza. I would gladly trade this one in for a replacement with less spices.

Bring an appetite! Some of the best pizza in Virginia. I got the “Outlaw” - which was peppery and contained more flavor than I think I’ve ever had in a pizza. It was so good I forgot to take pictures!

We ordered 2 pizzas to go and one of them was burned so bad we couldn't eat it. When we called to see if we could get another pizza, they said that they wouldn't replace the burned cheese pizza. I will definitely not go back again. Customer service was horrible and the pizza isn't that good either.
simply the best
Top notch happy hour and daily specials

We went in late on a Saturday afternoon after a long hike. We were very hungry and pizza sounded great. Our server must have been new, but she did fine. We got Caesar salad, which was plentiful and delicious. We followed that up with buttery, garlicky knots and two pizzas. We got the Southern Barbeque one with chicken, red onions, bbq sauce and bacon. We made up a white pizza, Roma tomatoes, sundried tomatoes and spinach. They were excellent. The crust was perfectly baked and the sauces were fantastic.

We took the leftovers home to Va Beach and enjoyed them cold that night and the next day. This place was super!!
Great pizza, chill vibes
Drinks are extremely sugary, especially for the prices. Band and multiple bars around building are a ton of fun! Pizza is average.
Great pizza nice staff
Best bar ever.
Great outside patio area!

Pizza took 45 minutes, was not even as good as Via Nova

I visited on May 22nd, at around 8pm

I’ve had the food before and it’s good, but it is such a hassle to order takeout from this place. Half the time their phone line is down and you can’t order. This time that happened I tried to place an order through their website that was also down. Frustrating.
Yummy

Had lunch here a couple of weeks ago with some coworkers.  There was only 1 other table of people eating.  Service (waiter) was slow and inattentive.  Pizza was ok but expensive ($24 for a large) and not really worth the money.  There's better pizza to be had on the corner for less money.
Good food, fun bar
I like their pizza crust.
Excellent pizza and salads. Very nice staff.
The best pizza I've eaten in a long time!! I'll return for sure!
Amazing pizza, convivial atmosphere, great drinks.
Comedy night ftw!
Staff was very nice and pizza was amazing! They have a cute outdoor patio with heaters.
Staff is very friendly. They pay attention to details and check with you about type of greeens, dressing on the side, type of meat, etc. The portions were generous.
Just had drinks here. Drinks were good, bartender was great. Atmosphere was great for the party crowd.
Awesome pizza right in c’ville! Had no idea Crozet Pizza had moved across from UVA. I had an awesome arugula, avocado, sundried tomato and pepperoni pizza!

Great pizza! Fun atmosphere. Not super expensive.... There were 7 people in our party. We ordered 3 medium pizzas (Buddhist, Yin, and Capone) and 6 beers total. For those of use who had a beer with our pizza, the bill was less than $15 each + tip. The waiter was really patient, nice, and professional. I would definitely go back if I was in Charlottesville again.
Always a huge fan of Crozet pizza and the Cville location is just as good.  We don’t go to cville without getting Crozet pizza and always bring another one home.
Lived up the the hype. Great crust, pizza was delicious.
The pizza is always on point and the outdoor patio is very relaxing in the summertime. Best time for a family outting is lunch on weekends or most weekday evenings.
Pizza is always excellent. Nice tucked away location.
Got the Special of the month pizza, the big Yang. Probably one of the best pizzas I've ever had!
Cute place! Pizza was very salty. Ease off the garlic salt and it could be pretty decent. Service was attentive and polite.
Great for college kids.
Best pizza ever
Awsome place. Great food great service.

I enjoyed the pizza I ordered, but I had to get up and find the waitress to ask why the garlic knots (which ended up being delicious) took 20 minutes to come out.

Overall I'd say besides the so-so service, the food was delicious.
Food is great. The upstairs has potential. Service wasn't great for our large group of 15 people at lunchtime.
Nothing like a great Buddhist Bar
Great pizza, love the location in Crozet!
Decent pizza
Had a great spinach, bacon and feta pizza with some lekker beer ... Thanx from South Africa
Very good pizza and service. The place was small inside and very crowded. We enjoyed getting takeout from here and the location was close to our home!
Good pizza. Not quite as busy as The Backyard used to be on Thursdays

The three stars are for the atmosphere and service which were the positive qualities of this pizzeria. The pizza and calzones, not so much. If it's good pizza you want, head over to Mellow Mushroom where you won't be disappointed. If you want the atmosphere especially of the college town, than you can't go wrong.

Fun bar / pizza place with a nice outdoor area. We wanted to sit outside because the weather was so nice and ended up at Crozet Pizza. The pizza was ok. They have a few decent beers. There was cornhole set-up too. The service was friendly. For wine they had only a house red and a house white of unknown grape. They also had some fun mixed drinks that my companion enjoyed.
